name: COLLINS, Dr Jessica

headline.note: Lowy nonprofit employment, ministerial study internship, party work, study, unpaid family care and elected office are excluded from public/private headlines. No sufficiently supported countable full-time interval established. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: Current first-party and former-employer biographies identify undergraduate anthropology study at the University of Sydney. Dates, load and concurrent employment are unresolved.

career_spells.evidence_note: Collins' current biography identifies an honours year at QUT; the Lowy biography says the project studied Samoan communities in Australia. Dates, scholarship terms, load and concurrent employment are unresolved.

career_spells.evidence_note: Her current and Lowy biographies identify the PhD subject. A journal author biography says Jessica Nancy Bird completed the QUT PhD between 2010 and 2013. A scholarship is mentioned but its funding, work obligations and any concurrent paid employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded; a scholarship does not by itself establish employment.

career_spells.role: Stay-at-home parent; academic publishing and master's study during the period
career_spells.evidence_note: Collins' current biography states that she spent seven years as a stay-at-home mother, published four academic papers and completed a Master of Global Development with Distinction. Calendar endpoints, any paid publishing or research contracts, and the master's institution and study dates are not supplied; the relative duration is not converted into invented dates. Follow-up identifies master’s institution as Griffith, recorded separately below. First speech confirms a study-linked ministerial internship during this broader period; neither seven-year care duration nor children’s ages is converted into endpoints.
career_spells.counting_note: Unpaid family care and study are excluded under the codebook; publications do not establish paid employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract records Lowy service within 2021–2025. Collins' current biography gives a November 2021 start and July 2024 promotion; the Lowy profile corroborates the research-fellow role. Exact days, hours, leave and any preceding employment are unresolved. First speech credits Jonathan Pryke with hiring her after family care. Current institutional page confirms charitable company limited by guarantee; public company legal form does not mean government control. No personal hours or leave evidence found.
career_spells.counting_note: The Lowy Institute is an independent nonprofit think tank; nonprofit employment is excluded from the public/private headline under the codebook.

First speech credits Jonathan Pryke with hiring her after family care. Current institutional page confirms charitable company limited by guarantee; public company legal form does not mean government control. No personal hours or leave evidence found.

research_notes: The current first-party biography materially improves the frozen year-only Lowy record with month-level start, promotion and resignation dates.
Senior research and director titles are not treated as proof of substantive full-time status.
Government grants or policy influence do not make an independently controlled nonprofit a public-sector employer.
Seven years of family care are preserved as unpaid work without back-calculating calendar endpoints.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01 added previously omitted ministerial internship, identified Griffith as master’s institution, recorded2019 party entry and clarified declined University of Fiji lectureship. Lowy employment hours remain unknown.

First speech says she was offered Fiji lecturing while awaiting doctoral examination and chose family formation instead; no Fiji employment spell created. Scholarly authorship and research affiliations do not establish university paid appointments. ADF Parliamentary Program participation is not military employment.

Public professional-profile2020 Griffith award is not a degree completion date. Master’s institution question resolved; calendar dates, scholarship conditions and teaching/research contracts remain open.

Searched personal qualifications, first speech, public LinkedIn, Lowy institutional material and annual/financial reports, QUT thesis and Hawke-office lead. LinkedIn direct999; QUT thesis restricted URL; official Parlinfo403, recovered through public Hansard transcript. Personal publications page timeout recovered. Crikey login wall not bypassed. No usable dated Lowy annual report or individual hours/leave record located.

Next follow-up: public Griffith internship/award records, QUT study funding and paid-teaching acknowledgements, historical Lowy governance and personnel terms; confirm whether Hawke-office work is solely the study internship. National queue advances without assuming no earlier employment.

Second follow-up 2 October 2026: no material enrichment. Targeted Griffith internship/year/award, Alex Hawke office, Lowy part-time/full-time terms and Jessica Nancy Bird scholarship searches found no new individual employment or study boundaries. Rechecked journal biography corroborates existing doctoral years; Lowy event profiles corroborate existing roles without hours or contracts.

Hawke-office descriptions remain secondary and do not prove a separate salaried staff appointment beyond the known study internship. Public-profile index adds publication title but no internship dates. Namesake clinical, actress and arts/design careers excluded; journal author affiliation is not paid-employment evidence. Restricted QUT thesis and earlier direct-profile denial not bypassed. Advance queue, retain personal Lowy hours/leave and pre2021 paid-work questions.

Third follow-up 2026-10-04: the legitimately public professional-profile index now exposes Griffith University education as 2020–2021, materially refining the Master of Global Development interval to year precision. It separately dates the academic-excellence award to 2020/issued 2021; award timing is not substituted for enrolment days. Targeted Griffith, QUT scholarship, Lowy and ministerial-internship searches found no individual contract, paid university appointment, hours or leave evidence. Other anonymised profile intervals were not assigned to institutions without an identity-safe mapping.
